notes: synthetic SCM; clean-room; U->T->M->Y with U->Y confounding and no direct T->Y edge (U unmeasured, absent from the graph); T=3+U+noise (uncentred), M=0.4*T+noise, Y=5*M+U+noise; the linear product of coefficients recovers 0.4*5=2, while either coefficient alone (0.4, 5) and the confounded Y~T slope (~3) are far outside the tolerance (about five standard errors at n=4000). The reported SE is checked against the closed-form delta-method SE of this SCM.
